messages:
emma_cs: Heads up — ACME renewal has an exceptional signature path. Procurement requires invoice split across two GLs and a different signer (VP Finance). Looping Jordan, Maria, Oliver. See PO they attached and comments below.

jordan_sales: Got it. Do we have the PO scanned? Who is the signer exactly?

emma_cs: PO attached in the customer thread. Signer: VP Finance (vf@acme.com). Billing split requested to GL 4301 (product) & 4302 (professional services). They want net45 terms.

maria_finance: We can support split invoicing but need: PO number on invoices, exact billing emails, and GL codes confirmed. Can we put both invoices under the same contract reference?

oliver_legal: Quick flag — if VP Finance is signing instead of the usual exec sponsor, we prefer an amendment that explicitly names the authorized signatory. Suggested text: `Section 2.1: Authorized Signatories — The parties agree that the person executing this Amendment on behalf of Customer has authority to bind Customer.` Will create a one-line amendment.

emma_cs: Customer prefers to sign in DocuSign. Procurement insists PO number be present on the signature page metadata. Maria — will that work?

maria_finance: Yes, PO# must appear on the invoice and we can include it as metadata on the DocuSign envelope. Also confirm billing emails to send split invoices to.

docu_sign_bot: DocuSign: Envelope created by emma_cs for 'Redwood Renewal Amendment' — envelope id ABC123. Status: sent.

jordan_sales: Pinged account exec to confirm sponsor OK with VP signing and to confirm the CC list for invoices.

emma_cs: Customer replied in-thread: "VP Finance (vf@acme.com) will sign; billing@acme.com for product; accounting@acme.com for services. PO# 5482. Net45."

maria_finance: Perfect — we'll issue two invoices referencing the same contract: INV-2026-01 (GL 4301) and INV-2026-02 (GL 4302). Both will reference PO# 5482 and the contract id. I need the signed amendment PDF to attach.

oliver_legal: I uploaded the one-line amendment with a single redline. Once DocuSign completes, I will merge amendment into the primary contract record and update contract metadata.

docu_sign_bot: DocuSign: Envelope ABC123 signed by vf@acme.com at 2026-02-14T14:03:12Z. Status: completed.

emma_cs: Received signed amendment PDF. Attaching to the contract record and notifying finance.

maria_finance: Received PDF, creating invoices now. Will schedule send for next business day and set payment terms to Net45. I'll CC billing@acme.com and accounting@acme.com on each respective invoice.

oliver_legal: Thanks — legal and procurement boxes checked. No further redlines.

emma_cs: Closing loop: renewal signed with alternate signer, amendment executed, split invoices queued. Thanks everyone :tada:

emma_cs: Notes/actions: 1) Attach signed amendment to contract. 2) Finance to send two invoices referencing PO# 5482. 3) Update customer record with billing contacts. 4) Mark renewal as complete in SFDC.
